verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with a substantial software stack (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Container Toolkit), so asking whether that stack tracks usage and can be opted out of is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions vendor telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The Device Metrics Exporter is user-side Prometheus monitoring, not vendor telemetry, so it does not count toward this story.
